summary.verdict: cap_pres-monotone (Exp-Dev) but NOT grounding-integrity-clean: 4 edges are operator->SCHOOL-family (UP), which under FORWARD+INSTANCE_OF would let T3/T4 operators terminate axiom-walk at a school TAG, not a real axiom -- a backwards false-grounding (same class Wave-1 banach-disease cleanup targeted).

issue: operator INSTANCE_OF its SCHOOL/organizing-family. SCHOOL atoms are categorization tags, NOT math foundations. Counting these as forward-grounding inverts direction (operator should ground DOWN to math, not UP to its label).

note: the 7 NEWLY-GROUNDED (Exp-Dev) are NA-tier CAP_/PP- capability atoms grounding DOWN to their implementing operators/macros -- legit, but they reach an axiom only transitively via that operator (and 2 of those operators, cascade_hmm_pipeline + discriminative_perceptron_pipeline, carry the UP-to-SCHOOL edges).
intra-tier is-a; both endpoints co-grounded; negligible axiom-reach change. Semantically legit is-a relations.

recommendation.auditor_lean: NO to naked FORWARD={DEPENDS_ON,SPECIALIZES,INSTANCE_OF}; the +7-atom benefit is small AND naked adoption introduces 4 SCHOOL-family false-groundings (backwards). TWO clean options for Director: (A) KEEP FROZEN at 24 + per-atom DEPENDS_ON rescue (Wave-3 precedent; handles wright_fisher-class without stack change) -- simplest, integrity-clean; (B) ADOPT but RESTRICTED: count INSTANCE_OF as forward-grounding ONLY when the target is a real foundation (lower T-tier, EXCLUDING SCHOOL/family-tag/organizing atoms) -- captures the +7 (well, the DOWN subset) without the 4 backwards. A naked unrestricted adoption is the one option to AVOID.
